paragraphs: Inseer sells web-based software that turns recorded video into ergonomic risk assessments. Video recorded on any device is uploaded and returned as a computer vision ergonomic assessment with a color-coded risk analysis. A centralized analytics dashboard identifies risks across the organization. The software also reports measurements of joint angles, force, and movement speed.

Safety teams are the stated audience, saving time and preventing injuries with the assessment solution. Warehouse teams are one named group, with the software tracking receiving, shipping, put-away, and picking tasks. Utility crews, medical teams, retail teams, manufacturing, and construction are the other settings listed.

Inseer was founded at the University of Iowa, with a mission to reduce musculoskeletal injuries. One testimonial is attributed to a senior risk consultant at Conner Strong & Buckelew. Another is attributed to an ergonomic specialist at Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America. A team of Certified Professional Ergonomists provides support.

quote.text: Developed by experts at the University of Iowa, our sensorless AI ergonomic assessment software analyzes risks in minutes, helping businesses stay ahead of workplace injuries.
